intent: 根据best-solution.md开始实现——提升交易系统胜率的15项代码改动

steps.completion_evidence: All 4 phases implemented and verified: optimizer win_rate objective, gate win_rate_threshold, profit_target_exit in _runtime, 3 param_space JSONs, min_conditions in 3 templates, profit targets + trailing stops in 6 templates, strength-weighted consolidation, per-strategy risk budgets, per-strategy Kelly sizing

boundary_contract.in_scope: best-solution.md 中的 15 项改动：Phase 1 基础设施(4项) + Phase 2 入场放松(4项) + Phase 3 出场改进(4项) + Phase 4 信号管线(3项)
boundary_contract.out_of_scope: Elliott Wave 策略改动、funding_rate 策略优化、AI 因子模块、新增策略模板、部署/运维改动
boundary_contract.constraints: 增量实现不破坏现有功能、ruff format/lint 通过、mypy 类型检查通过、现有测试通过

execution_criteria: Phase 1: optimizer.py 增加 win_rate 分支、gate.py 支持 win_rate 目标、_runtime.py 新增 profit_target_exit()、config/strategies/ 创建 param_space JSON
Phase 2: trend_following/mean_reversion/volatility_breakout 增加 min_conditions 参数、RSI 阈值纳入 param_space
Phase 3: 所有模板接入 profit_target_exit、trailing stop、mean_reversion 出场改进、RSI-adaptive profit target
Phase 4: generator.py 加权合并、RiskEngine 策略级预算、PositionSizer 策略级 Kelly

task_decomposition.title: Phase 1 基础设施：win_rate 优化目标 + 止盈函数 + param_space
task_decomposition.done_when: optimizer.py 支持 win_rate、gate.py 支持 win_rate、profit_target_exit() 存在、param_space JSON 文件创建
evidence: gate.py 含 win_rate 默认值

task_decomposition.title: Phase 2 入场放松：min_conditions + RSI param_space
task_decomposition.done_when: 3 个模板支持 min_conditions、RSI 阈值可优化

task_decomposition.title: Phase 3 出场改进：止盈接入 + trailing stop + BB opposite + RSI-adaptive
task_decomposition.done_when: 所有模板使用 profit_target_exit、mean_reversion 出场改为 opposite band
evidence: 6 模板 generate_signals 调用 profit_target_exit

task_decomposition.title: Phase 4 信号管线：加权合并 + 策略级风控 + Kelly
task_decomposition.done_when: generator.py 使用加权合并、RiskEngine 支持策略级预算、PositionSizer 使用策略级 win_rate

classification_rationale.pattern_matched: execute — 用户明确要求'开始实现'，best-solution.md 提供完整分析+计划
